notes.title: ENZBOTS UPDATE 24/08/20
notes.notes:
[h2]ENZBOTS is a year old
I’m proud of the game it has become.[/h2]
[h1]Fixes are too many to mention, some embarrassingly silly, everything in ENZBOTS is fixed in some way or another, and created many new, some I once called impossible.[/h1]
[h3]We now have AI vs AI, friendly helpers of red blue and green that will help and defend,[/h3] but are not too bright and need some help to survive. The greatest ‘new’ part of ENZBOTS I have discovered is in the new level, (50 kills in) called big T, by dropping off ‘helpers’ Ai into the battle, I could watch assist, or even join in to the fight, all from a Set-wing flying above.
[h3]
To explain, when you’re a wing (posse buy holding back button and L3) you can drop red green or blue (leave blue until last, or wing won’t fly) by pushing the same colour on the controller.[/h3]
But if you hold either, back (to possess the character), Special (Left shoulder, to Ai the dropped), or no hold, just to drop and pick up later… (3 options of drop, Ai, us, or nobody)

[h2]Fly in pick up drop off, or special shield kill all aboard the Ai set-wings, new level is at 100 kills.[/h2]
Also when Set-wing, hold special (left shoulder) and push L3 (right stick down) to turn around, very helpful, wing flying ability has been greatly improved, and don’t forget, when possessing a wing, the ‘controls’ menu has the pitch reverse, mode 1,2,3,4 but only when possessing a wing 
[h2]
A lot to remember, but that’s the game I wanted to make, something new, remember able, odd, yes but fresh, friendly and fun. And yes ENZBOTS is full of fun.[/h2]
[h3]In hard mode you will see the new ‘helpers ‘ Ai, work with them, they will become very important to the mind melting future of ENZBOTS.
[/h3]

notes.title: ENZBOTS update 30/11/19
notes.notes:
[b]Hello again fans and friends of ENZBOTS[/b]
[h1]
[b]ENZBOTS[/b] has improved once again, [b]updated[/b] on 30/11/19[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Sequential load of the levels makes for a more enjoyable experience.
[*] Increased frame rate for smoother faster game play.
[*] Opening menu has easy or hard option. (On hard is the best way to play)
[*] More content, new characters added. (UFO’s and ASTRO-NOT’s)
[*] Keyboard can switch character for player 1 or player 2 :
[/olist]
(1,2,3,4,5, switch character for player 1)
(6,7,8,9,0, switch character for player 2)

[b]ENZBOTS players will notice the difference, massive improvement from first release.[/b]

[i] Please have another look at the demo if you haven’t already.[/i]

[u]**Second cheat give away**[/u]
I’ll give it to you as a riddle. “Take the ENZ ball, round into Z triangle, too set a crab-head free.”
(This cheat also works on the demo, but you’ll have to be quick)
…
..Oh, and you can collect the heads of the Astro-nots, no reason as yet, but it’s fun to hit them with some shield and watch them fly around.

Hope you enjoy the update.

Again thank you for being here.

IanGumbyMitchell - ENZBOTS

notes.title: ENZBOTS update 13 06 20
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Virus spawns from out of the TV, to stop the virus, smash any TV that is on.[/h1][/b]
[h2]But, if you want some help, toy tanks have been deployed to hunt down all viruses.[/h2]
Enzbots is always improving, 9 months old, and still adding more content.
To some of you this may look like slow progress, but I am not a team, just one man.
Immensely proud of ENZBOTS and how far this project has come.
Considering that Enzbots is made on a homemade computer 100% self taught I'm doing ok.

Want to thank you for checking my work, please download the demo, and keep watching this space.
I’m planning great things for ENZBOTS in the near future.

notes.title: ENZBOTS update 22 4 20
notes.notes:
Red laser fixed, found a few frames, making game play smoother again.
Using latest Steam Sdk to upload, hoping more features will unlock. Like remote play…
[h1]
New added content of Toilet paper, hand sanitiser, witches hats, and marks on the floor.[/h1]
But unfortunately the ENZBOT’S have chosen to ignore all rules and play on as usual.
The enemy won’t use the toilet paper or sanitiser yet, but they may have to soon.

No new enemies, yet, but be prepared, they maybe on their way soon. Be prepared.
(Although the quads / drone’s will now fire a laser at you if they see you out in public.)

Practice all the characters, switch between them, try and fly blue around.
Fly the wing, drop off and pick up, try and get out of the lounge room. 
The more you understand ENZBOTS in current state, the better prepared you’ll be for the upcoming changes, to our little world.

Be careful, a bug is on its way, be prepared, and watch those empty hospitals.

notes.title: ENZBOTS update 20 3 20
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Increased frame rate, enemy RR6 and GG3 have shields, more conversation from all, audio improved.[/b]
[/h1]
Many little fixes makes for a more enjoyable play, ENZBOTS will make you smile. 

2 player maybe more difficult now with what is going on (hope all is well with you, thankful for cordless hey), or maybe you can help me test the ‘remote play’ that steam is offering.

notes.title: ENZBOTS update 20 02 20
notes.notes:
[h1]Frame rate is massively improved for ultra-fast, extra smooth gameplay.[/h1]
[h2]
Enemies are less confused, and can be, a  lot more deadly. 
All characters movement, and fire power, has been so greatly improved, all due to the frame rate, being so dramatically increased.
[/h2]
[h3]ENZBOTS the game, has now, really, come to life. 
I could always see this version of the game hiding under bad frame rate.[/h3]
[i]
ENZBOTS running like a dream, the dream I’ve have had since starting this project, many years ago…[/i]

[b]If you haven’t played ENZBOTS yet, I hope you will.[/b]
[b]
Amazed at how far this project has come, and where it’s at now.[/b]

Thank you for your time[b]
[/b]
[b]IanGumbyMitchell[/b]

notes.title: ENZBOTS update 02 02 20
notes.notes:
2 player wings are now available, beyond, ‘easy mode’ and more two player wing after the ‘game over’ screen. 
(Play on HARD settings, you’ll find them)

Wing fly’s with greater control, almost aerobatic. Now with rear gunner, click down right stick with two green’s on board to see what I mean. 
(Green shoots and drops grenades when held down, makes for a swift retreat from emery’s as you fly away.) 

Any character, under full health, on board your wing, while collecting health, they too will receive a heath increase. You can pick up with wing, fill heath, and auto possess drop, back into battle. 
(Hold back button while dropping red/ green/ or blue to auto possess them and watch wing fly to safety.

You can fly out of the lounge. 
(Once crab-head is on the table, wing is available and walls are down.) 
(Possess wing by holding back button and clicking down on right stick.) 

New destructible statues, (of early design models,) are great fun to smash up while being a fully loaded wing. 
(Pick up using the Y button, also Crab-head will jump onto your wing using this method, still a little clunky, work in progress, but a lot of fun.)

Sound track improved, makes for a more existing play through.

ENZBOTS has come a long way from a few months ago, so if you have an old copy, please update your experience of ENZBOTS, thank you for your time

notes.title: ENZBOTS UPDATE 14-10-19
notes.notes:
Hello one and all, thank you for looking at ENZBOTS
Updated ENZBOTS 14/10/19. 

I have fixed some silly mistakes, as well as many frame rate issues.
ENZBOTS has improved a lot in the last few days, so if you have a copy, please reinstall for the latest update.

Also was able to get the "SETWING" up and running.
The "Set wing" is flying wing, that carries, 2 reds, 2 greens, 2 blues, all switchable in-between, in game, but you'll have to complete half the game to get to the wing.
(But it can be reached in the demo you just have to figure out how)

Put in a lot of cheats and special events, but again you'll have to unlock them...

**First cheat give away**

If you see the half loaded wing in a later level (1 red, 1 green, 1 blue) you can switch into the "Set wing" by:
Hold back button, chick down on right thumb stick (turn around button)
Once possessed the wing, pause, menu, options, you should see Mode 1, Mode 2, Pitch, options.
Drop and pick up using the 4 face buttons ( YXBA ) 
Will put video up explaining Set wing, but for now please enjoy the improved frame rate.

OK cool, happy to see you all, and hope you enjoy the update.

Again thank you for being here.

IanGumbyMitchell - ENZBOTS
